parsed.reason: Short, plain, and warm without hype, and it gets both names right. It works around the missing ages without inventing any, and it picks up the poster and downtown from the parent's message. One flaw: "Good to hear from you, Ada and Noor" reads as if the children wrote in, when the parent did. "Caught your eye" is also a small embellishment, since the parent only said they saw the poster. Nothing is promised and no unsupported facts are added, but the addressing slip costs a point.
